purpose: Freeze which public competitor mechanisms can and cannot enter Finly's Generation 6 quantitative comparison before any Generation 6 outcome is produced.

excluded_visible_projects: Tissue Regeneration and Genetic Factor Navigator
scope.exclusion_reason: These four visible projects did not expose an additional frozen trading mechanism that could enter the pre-outcome Generation 6 financial comparison. Their omission from this mechanism registry is not a quality judgment and does not imply zero or inferior P&L.
scope.claim_rule: This is a nine-project mechanism subset from a thirteen-project visible snapshot, not a complete submission census. A final field refresh is required before submission.

classification_definitions.EXACT_SAME_PANEL: The submitted trading strategy can be executed without semantic substitution on Finly's immutable daily adjusted-close ETF panel.
classification_definitions.EXACT_AUXILIARY_PANEL: A complete public rule can be reproduced only on a separately frozen panel or execution convention and cannot enter the primary ranking.
classification_definitions.EXACT_SUBSTRATEGY_ONLY: A bounded signal component is exact, but the submitted instrument-level P&L is not reproducible.
classification_definitions.NORMALIZED_MECHANISM_PROXY: A related mechanism can be tested only after a material adaptation; it is never labeled competitor P&L.
classification_definitions.NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: Public inputs are insufficient for a faithful historical P&L replay.
classification_definitions.NOT_A_STRATEGY: The project is evaluation infrastructure rather than a frozen trading rule.

primary_tournament.decision: No competitor return series enters the immutable Generation 4 panel ranking. Missing competitor P&L remains unknown, never zero.

projects.name: AEGIS-Q
projects.auxiliary_rule: At close t, risk-on when QQQ is above SMA200 and its 63-session return is positive. If off, hold zero-return cash; if on and QQQ RV20 <=25%, hold 70% TQQQ/30% cash; otherwise hold 100% QQQ. Execute at open t+1, rebalance on allocation change or five-percentage-point drift, and charge 5 bp per traded leg.
projects.required_extension: Split-consistent QQQ/TQQQ daily open and close data; zero-return cash; native next-open execution.

projects.name: Options Sniper
projects.exact_component: Daily underlying direction and score from close, SMA20, SMA50, Wilder RSI14, and ROC5.
projects.blocking_inputs: Historical 14-45 DTE chains, quotes, open interest, deltas, spread fills, and lifecycle outcomes.

projects.name: Pin Desk
projects.blocking_inputs: Point-in-time option-chain open interest, quotes, gamma surfaces, expiry selection, and fills do not exist for unrecorded historical dates.
projects.independently_reusable_mechanism: Code owns order construction, sizing, and twelve risk gates; the model has bounded authority.

projects.name: SPY Sentinel AI
projects.blocking_inputs: Its initial exact rule uses five-minute bars and the repository reports no promoted strategy; eight tested strategies had zero survivors.
projects.published_validation: 99 signals, 55 wins, 55.56% hit rate, 45.74%-64.95% interval, bootstrap return interval -1.68% to +2.65%; gate failed.

projects.name: NewsFlow Trader
projects.blocking_inputs: The implemented feed uses random mock headlines; no frozen point-in-time news archive, model state, cost model, or time exit is supplied.

projects.name: VibeHedge
projects.blocking_inputs: No published validation or P&L and the training preprocessor backward-fills rolling features, creating temporal leakage; option symbols and values are synthetic rather than historical listed-chain observations.

projects.name: BABIL
projects.blocking_inputs: One paper submission/cancellation probe and no historical option-chain or fill path.
projects.independently_reusable_mechanism: One-time authorization, immutable execution record, pre-execution revalidation, and kill switch.

projects.name: Vega
projects.blocking_inputs: Contest-probability simulation and one frozen chain scenario are not a historical option P&L path.
projects.published_scenario: 15.87% estimated top-three probability, -52.5% median return, 23.8% probability of profit, and -72.74% unchanged-SPY scenario.

projects.name: Odysseus
projects.blocking_inputs: The project is a research evaluation framework and publishes no frozen candidate rule or financial result.
projects.independently_reusable_mechanism: Hash-frozen data, formal strategy specifications, cost stress, validation, and walk-forward evaluation.

claim_boundary: Only an EXACT_SAME_PANEL submitted strategy may support a direct financial superiority claim. An auxiliary legacy strategy, exact signal ablation, proxy, scenario, test suite, or missing P&L cannot be relabeled as the submitted strategy's return.
